author: SCP38
quote: Played this for several hours, and I'm sad I can't get those back. Is the game visually beautiful? Absolutely. And that's why it gets any score at all. The gameplay feels clunky, the story is ridiculous, and the two main characters are insipid. She abandons her baby to go rob something, and then, when she gets out, decides the best way to get her kid back is to become a bigger criminal. Meanwhile, the doofus she hooked up with apparently did absolutely nothing to regain custody from DCF after she was tossed in prison. He has all of the facial expressions and tone inflections of Bella in the first Twilight movie. They have no chemistry and no real motivations other than the fact that they're clearly idiots. Perhaps bringing a baby into a GTA storyline was just a really dumb idea. I thoroughly enjoyed the other GTA games. But this...this has none of the humor or fun. If they put out an online multiplayer like GTA 5 has, remove some of the "realistic" drudgery, and add back some of the freedom to create absolute chaos for the fun of it, I might circle back to it because the setting is pretty. Otherwise, I'm going to go play through GTA 5 again and then head back to my character in the multiplayer game. Sorry, Rockstar, this was a miss. What were you thinking?
